主要内容: The Federal Reserve issued Supervisory Letter SR 15-6 on April 6, 2015, addressing frequently asked questions (FAQs) related to the Regulatory Capital Rule. This guidance applies to state member banks, bank holding companies, and savings and loan holding companies supervised by the Federal Reserve, including those with $10 billion or less in consolidated assets. The letter clarifies expectations regarding the regulatory capital rules, covering topics such as the definition of capital, high-volatility commercial real estate (HVCRE) exposures, real estate and off-balance-sheet exposures, equity exposures to investment funds, qualifying central counterparties, and credit valuation adjustments. FAQs relevant only for advanced approaches banking organizations are marked with an asterisk (*). The letter also supersedes several previous SR letters, including SR 10-4, SR 05-13, SR 02-16, SR 02-12, and SR 02-4. Questions about the regulatory capital rule and FAQs should be directed to Andrew Willis, Justyna Milweski, or Matthew McQueeney in the Board’s Capital and Regulatory Policy Section. The regulatory capital rule is codified at 12 CFR 217 (Regulation Q).
